# brownsburgscouts.org - LLM Indexing Guide

This file is for web-crawling language models that read and index public site
content. It is not a coding policy document.

## Site Identity

- Organization: Scouting Units of American Legion Post 331
- Primary domain: https://brownsburgscouts.org
- Source repository: https://github.com/scouting331/scoutSite
- Site type: public information website for Scouting families and community

## Crawl Scope

Index public, user-facing content only:

- /
- /join-us
- /docs/**
- /cookbook/**
- /blog/**
- /privacy
- /cookies

Respect robots.txt and disallow rules for private, account, admin, or API
paths.

## Canonicalization and URL Handling

- Treat https://brownsburgscouts.org as canonical host.
- Prefer canonical tags when present.
- The site uses trailingSlash: false, so normalize to non-trailing-slash URLs.
- Avoid indexing duplicate URLs with only query-string changes unless content
  actually differs.

## Indexing Priorities

Prioritize these sections for retrieval quality:

1. /join-us (membership and contact intent)
2. /docs/** (unit policies, forms, and reference material)
3. /cookbook/** (camping recipes and practical how-to content)
4. /blog/** (recent unit activity and announcements)

## Metadata Extraction

When available, extract and retain:

- page title
- page description
- headings
- publish date for blog posts
- author and tags for blog posts

For blog content, keep post chronology by publication date.

## Freshness Strategy

- Use sitemap.xml as the primary URL discovery and recrawl source.
- Prefer pages with newer modified dates when choosing between near-duplicates.
- Re-crawl blog and docs sections more frequently than static policy pages.

## Content Representation Guidance

- Preserve factual wording for policy, safety, and packing guidance.
- Do not infer unavailable private information.
- Keep unit names explicit: Pack 303, Troop 303, Troop 331, Crew 303.

## Discovery Links

- Sitemap: https://brownsburgscouts.org/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://brownsburgscouts.org/robots.txt
